query: Please implement a fintech customer portal website to provide financial services. The website should have functionalities for user registration, login, viewing account information, and transaction records. Users should be able to log in, view their account information, including balance and transaction records, and perform transfer and payment operations. Apply theme using pink as background and deeppink for elements.
